Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Easterbrook
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 01/29/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 139 as introduced proposed a Constitutional Amendment relating to Choctaw County, which if ratified, would provide for the Legislature, by general or local law, to fix, alter, and regulate the costs and charges of court and other fees to be charged and collected by a county officer, including fees charged and collected for service of process.  This amendment further ratifies and confirms any act authorizing the levy of additional court costs or fees enacted prior to the adoption of the amendment.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023 by an estimated $100,000.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Shaver
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/26/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House 240 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

This amendment further ratifies and confirms any act authorizing the levy of additional court costs or fees enacted prior to the adoption of the amendment.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023 by an estimated $100,000.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
